Participating governed writers affecting the same worktree and shared canonical or governed source state use one transaction coordinator for final mutation. At most one writer lease governs that worktree, binding process/session identity, acquisition time, relevant dependency-scoped state and compiled-against snapshot identity, heartbeat or stale-lock recovery information, and explicit release. Isolated worktrees may run independent write-heavy packets with their own leases. Workers return proposed canonical authority/lens/rule deltas for coordinator integration; inspection or preparation grants no mutation authority.

Apply ownership to actual affected shared state and the participating-writer protocol, not every filesystem artifact. Independently owned per-attempt runtime observations and evidence outputs do not require a new global source-writer lock merely because they persist. Preserve accepted lifetime shared operation access, exclusive migration access and existing writer-lease/journal behavior without nested acquisition. Independent output ownership cannot bypass coordination when an operation actually mutates shared governed state.

Historical blanket coordinator wording is limited by accepted host execution/readiness policy: this is cooperative integrity, not confinement or exclusion of hostile same-user code, nonparticipating legacy processes or arbitrary host edits. Native Node and host-configured permissions remain supported; no mandatory sandbox or WSL bridge is reintroduced. Hashes and leases do not prove interference impossible. The purpose is to prevent participating shared-state writers corrupting each other without serializing unrelated observation artifacts or inventing a security backend.

This is a current governed execution/recovery obligation, not deferred future work. Existing leases/coordinators are candidate implementation evidence; exact consumer and conflict/recovery evidence must establish fulfillment. Rank concrete unresolved obligations and repair questions using observed effect and blocking status, with stable issue identity and state-bound evidence. Accepted meaning, satisfied predicates or an explicit valid deferral may settle an issue; relevant new facts reopen it without reopening unrelated decisions. A cleanup plan must identify actionable repairs and cannot claim execution or a complete design from unavailable evidence.

An agent's assertion that work is done is non-normative. Completion requires current bindings, reconciled affected units, required evidence, allowed unknowns, and explicit unavailable external actions. Evidence identifies its lane, source, independence, side effects, and assurance; tests produced by the same packet or sharing the same flawed suite are correlated, and a model cannot solely validate its own compression. Release proof binds stable obligation IDs to observed results from the same revision and worktree with distinct negative controls; self-report, caller counts, hash-shaped strings, and default-zero metrics do not count.

Separate exclusion policy for inventory, inference authority, mutation, reporting, model context, and coverage denominator. Vendored code may remain inventoried for dependencies while excluded from mutation and pattern authority; generated outputs may remain in reconciliation while excluded as independent authority evidence; secrets or configuration values may be inventoried structurally while excluded from model context. Apply this obligation together with executable-lens authority and scoped-invalidation obligations.

Audit, completion, migration and interrupted transactions must yield resumable cleanup/continuation plans. Required bounded saved-context and lifecycle continuation reports current/stale/unknown evidence, missing advisory notes/artifacts, unresolved work, recovery-required state and the supported next action through existing services and the shared runner. owner.title: Make architectural knowledge executable
owner.statement:
An active architectural lens must select relevant observed units and contribute executable constraints or validators with explicit authority and assumptions. For handwritten code, accept different implementations that satisfy the predicates. Require exact output only when the lens explicitly owns deterministic generation. A prose description or an unregistered validator cannot establish conformance.

Host instructions are regenerable projections of canonical rules and state, and a hard rule cannot survive only as compact prose. An integration claim requires the actual authority, public composition and consumer, invalidation, observability, dogfood, installed delivery, and distinct positive and severed-edge evidence; a label, proxy, constant hash, or default-zero metric does not prove the mechanism is connected.

Selector, lens-membership, and effective-rule evaluation respects governance strata. Cross-cutting constraints may depend on lower-layer classifications but must not create feedback in which a rule changes the facts granting its own authority. Evaluate declared recursive rule or lens groups as strongly connected components with monotonic semantics or an explicit fixed-point function. A repeated state digest must distinguish convergence from a detected cycle, and an iteration limit must terminate evaluation. Nonconvergent or unevaluable governance cannot pass.

Mutating transforms have an applicability check, preview, apply, verification, and risk-appropriate recovery. They must be idempotent or declare bounded convergent fixed-point behavior; declare touched Projection Units, write scope, preconditions and dependency-scoped state binding; preview before applying; fail closed on unresolved semantic anchors; preserve unrelated formatting where practical; emit structured operation evidence; and verify postconditions. R1 changes provide rollback; higher-risk changes provide compensation or explicit irreversibility under the applicable policy.

Composition declares predecessor dependencies, mutual exclusions, commutativity, exclusive unit claims, postconditions, and fixed-point or convergence behavior. Unresolved overlapping exclusive claims block planning. Dependency cycles are explicit strongly connected components only when declared convergent; otherwise they are plan errors. These obligations require scoped invalidation and the recovery discipline retained by reverse reconciliation.

The complete public governance-termination checks and canonical transform-composition workflow remain explicitly unrealized by this ingestion. Existing internal contracts are partial implementation evidence, not proof of connected behavior. Reconsider missing governance checks when a supported evaluation or audit consumer needs their disclosed results, and canonical composition fields only when a named supported transform workflow cannot preserve these obligations using the existing Requirement and Scenario shapes. Do not infer a new schema or realization from a historical type alone.

Assess promotion of a lens or rule by governance impact as well as physical mutation risk. A mechanically reversible record can impose cross-package blocking consequences and therefore require higher governance review. Inferred patterns remain descriptive candidates until explicitly accepted with eligible authority and executable enforcement. Registered operation policy must resolve contradictory inputs explicitly; neither a small diff nor a permissive host changes the accepted meaning, required evidence or exact mutation authority.

owner.statement:
After arbitrary repository edits, compare current observations with retained bindings, predicted impact and applicable lens obligations. Report stale reasoning separately from actual architectural violations. Accept alternate conforming implementations. Retain Planning Surprises and candidate relationships as state-bound derived evidence with a concrete repair route; explicit acceptance is required before inferred relationships become authoritative. The bounded control loop must compare post-change observation with predicted impact, classify scope growth, missing relationships, and overreach, and reach a fixed point or report the unresolved frontier. It may propose a reusable relation from observed surprise evidence but must never learn or authorize a false relation from unrelated edits.

Choose repairs in this order, recording why cheaper or safer strategies are unavailable or insufficient: reuse when an eligible exact or validated signature permits backdating; revalidate when a validator establishes sufficient proof; repair upstream and regenerate a generated unit with known upstream source and generator; apply a safe reversible deterministic patch to a non-generated governed unit; use bounded agent repair for shared handwritten semantics only when policy allows; widen analysis when coverage or proof is insufficient; otherwise request a human decision. This ordering depends on scoped invalidation and evidence-bound completion rather than a mapping alone.

Direct edits to generated output or a Representation Projection with a known generator or source are forbidden by default. Normally repair upstream canonical semantics or the representation profile, regenerate, and validate both the generated result and semantic preservation. A temporary generated-output overlay is allowed only as an explicit migration or debt record with owner, rationale, invalidation conditions, and exit criteria. Keep the exception and its removal conditions visible.

Full ordered repair selection, explanations, and overlay handling remain active but explicitly unrealized as public routing by this ingestion. Reconsider when the host-owned investigate, propose, accept, repair, verify loop or cleanup workflow must select among these strategies and expose the rejected cheaper alternatives. Bind only an observed selector and explanation consumer; existing strategy enums and recovery types do not prove this policy is implemented.

Recovery distinguishes incomplete effects from committed-but-unpublished evidence. Preserve the last durable checkpoint and authenticate required post-observation evidence; never rerun committed effects just to republish an already committed result. Safe rollback or historical publication must not depend on missing advisory preparation notes, and missing notes never justify fabricated prepared-success evidence. Governed shared-state mutation follows cooperative worktree ownership; independently owned observation artifacts do not acquire a new global writer lock from this obligation.

entries.title: Reconsider architecture when its reasons change

owner.title: Reconsider architecture when its reasons change
owner.statement:
Retain architectural decisions about patterns, libraries, platforms, boundaries and implementation strategy together with alternatives, reasons, constraints, assumptions, evidence, tradeoffs and applicable scope. Make the choice and why retrievable before affected edits and after a fresh clone. Reconsider only affected decisions when those inputs or scope change; preserve the historical influence of adopted soft preferences. New non-advisory consequences require actual linked canonical products in the same accepted transaction. Neither an old approval nor repeating existing code proves that the decision remains suitable. Unsupported or stale validity evidence stays explicit.

Agents and model providers may submit structured proposals but cannot silently promote governance, change authority, validators or scope, persist exceptions, redefine identity, or perform highest-risk or external actions. General orchestration, modernization, watch mode, and external adapters remain future capabilities until a real consumer reopens them; external adapters then require explicit capability, observability, relevance, impact, drift, snapshot, and open-world evidence.

Material mutable option sets or constraints require fresh-enough concern-scoped evidence: current capabilities, support/security/lifecycle, changed alternatives, uncertain official constraints, contradictory local evidence or significant long-lived technology commitments. Verify the current viable options, not remembered choices decorated with citations. Do not research merely because time passed or perform a periodic repository-wide best-practices crawl. Record source, capture date, available source date/version, excerpt hash or concise excerpt, confidence and applicability; prefer official/primary evidence. Offline cached evidence exposes freshness. If policy requires unavailable fresh evidence for a blocking decision, block automatic acceptance; an explicit user decision may proceed with recorded uncertainty within actual authorization and remaining hard constraints. Research does not prove local implementation or force migration.

Hard constraints dominate preferences; explicitly adopted project preferences govern shared recommendations over softer organization/user preferences. Conflicting soft preferences remain visible and nonblocking unless explicitly promoted into constraints. Retain material preference influence by semantic hash; later personal changes do not retroactively revise accepted project architecture unless adopted as assumptions. Option evaluation should use a tradeoff matrix and eliminate infeasible options before optional weighted ranking; expose weights rather than claiming objective probability. Deferral needs a neutral/compatibility-preserving route, rationale, scope, preserved options, forbidden commitments, revisit triggers and risk/unknowns. A guardrail that commits to an option is a temporary decision, not concealed neutrality.

Modernization uses this same concern/evaluation/authority/consequence system. Trigger it from observed divergence, agent difficulty, surprises/missed relevance, broad invalidation, duplication, unsupported dependencies, security/support issues, slow feedback, erosion, repeated overlays, platform incompatibility or user request. Identify the problem before technology, with current/target state, observed cost, alternatives, evidence/counterevidence, affected meaning/relevance/units, compatibility, phases, rollback, cleanup, risk and confidence. Reject fashion-driven changes when current fit costs less, support is immature, migration exceeds recurring pain, scale benefits are speculative, rationale mismatches local constraints, or reversibility/evidence is weak. Approved modernization becomes a semantic change with appropriate transition obligations; it is not persisted-format upgrade readiness.

owner.title: Demonstrate cumulative value on Projector itself
owner.statement:
Use Projector knowledge to guide a real change and a subsequent change in a fresh session, detect deliberately stale knowledge, and compare the combined setup, retrieval, repair, and maintenance cost with a capable ordinary agent using search, code, tests, and concise notes. Passing self-authored tests does not prove economic advantage. Retire historical planning material only after useful intent and rationale are recoverable through the working system.

Measure the semantic machinery itself, including cache behavior, invalidation and backdating, identity and relevance quality, context and representation cost, deterministic mutation, rollback, analyzer limits, and benchmark outcomes. The goal is lower marginal reasoning and review cost; model growth faster than useful application is debt. Do not fabricate absent measures as zero. Release remains manual, source-independent, and non-publishing until an explicit later action; passing self-authored tests or a historical checklist does not prove economic advantage or full release completeness.

Where feasible, inferred enforcement should be evaluated against repository history and semantic perturbations before activation. Check independent persistence of examples, later fixes/co-change/migration direction, shared ancestry, alternative explanations from tests/incidents, intentional variants and nearby generated cases. Separate exogenous evidence from changes caused by Projector: a migration demanded by a lens cannot independently support that lens. Shadow evaluation reports true positives, intentional variants wrongly flagged, possible prevented defects, transform applicability and false positives; pair small-sample percentages with counts and uncertainty. Evaluation never silently changes governance. Broad historical-evaluation automation remains unrealized until a named consumer and trustworthy history/perturbation evidence justify it; required release controls and actual source-absent self-development measurements are not deferred.

Reopen affected design when observed evidence shows maintenance cost near/exceeding ordinary review; systematically missed dependencies despite claimed coverage; rebuild needing hidden history; overclaimed signatures; correlated conformance missing shared bugs; governance cycles/ad hoc ordering; impractical canonical collaboration; conflicts needing prompt surgery; ordinary instructions/codemods nearly matching held-out results; repository-sized capsules; package-tree duplication for relevance; recurring synonymous identities; unsafe or globally stale bindings; lossy or net-negative representation; reduced task success from compression; endogenous authority dominance; unactionable divergence; routine forbidden generated-output patches; dishonest interruption recovery; adoption needing manual ontology authoring; or growing model/rule complexity without declining marginal reasoning/review cost. These are evidence-driven design feedback, not defects to hide with more rules or relabel as optional. They do not require a new economic trial, universal superiority proof or completed Psychord rebuild before delivery; use the already required real-work measurements and disclose missing evidence.

If a correction/shadow-lens decision uses paired probes, specify both expected outcomes independently; both must be correct. Count invalid pairs and oracle errors separately.

Comparative claims require matched initial states, equal tasks/tools/models/resources/reveals, accumulated code preserved through fresh-agent checkpoints, and separate new-behavior/regression grading by predeclared independent oracles. Retain failures, setup errors, timeouts, unavailable and aborted attempts. Report observed setup, retrieval/context, model/tool, deterministic, evidence, human review/repair and canonical-maintenance costs with units/pricing provenance; missing costs are unavailable. These are optional protocols, not delivery prerequisites or required paid trials.
